race.title: Light Up A Life Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Chase
race.verdict: MR LINCOLN improved on his hurdles form at the first attempt over fences with a strong-travelling victory at Hexham and he can build on that effort to score again. The biggest threat looks to be Air Apparent , who is also open to progress after his successful chasing debut at Bangor last month. MR LINCOLN AIR APPARENT (IRE) GALIDAM (FR)
race.bettingForecast: Mr Lincoln (11/8), Air Apparent (11/4), Cuzco Du Mathan (6/1), Tommys Law (7/1), Divas Doyen (10/1), Galidam (12/1)
